overviewParagraphs: Vattanac Golf Resort East Course is one of the most culturally immersive golf experiences available anywhere in Asia — a Sir Nick Faldo design that integrates scale reproductions of Pre-Angkorean architectural structures throughout the course, creating an outdoor gallery of Khmer heritage that is as educationally extraordinary as it is visually stunning. Golfers encounter these sculptural features at tee boxes, along fairway corridors, and near greens throughout the round.

Faldo's routing on the East Course is designed to showcase these cultural landmarks at their most dramatic — elevated tee positions provide perspective on the scale of the sculptures, and approach shots framed by temple structures create photographs that no conventional golf course can rival. The golf itself is a genuine championship examination: accurate iron play is rewarded, while spray shots encounter both the sculptural features and the natural bunkering that characterises Faldo's design style globally.

As a public-access layout, the East Course provides visiting discerning golfers with a genuine Faldo design experience at Cambodia's most prestigious resort address. AGS views this course as an essential component of any Phnom Penh golf program — the combination of championship golf quality and Cambodian cultural immersion is unmatched anywhere else in the country.

curatorBriefHtml: Vattanac Golf Resort’s East Course (opened 2019 by Sir Nick Faldo just east of Phnom Penh) is Cambodia’s showstopper championship test — famous worldwide for weaving dramatic, full-scale architectural replicas of Angkor Wat, Preah Vihear, and Bayon directly into immaculate Paspalum fairways and lakes. Measuring 6,401 yards from the Blue Tees (7,467 yards Tips, Par 72), the East Course pairs bold water hazards and aggressive bunkering with full floodlit night golf.

Having played Vattanac East personally, it is easily one of the most memorable modern golf spectacles in Southeast Asia — equally thrilling in crisp morning sunlight or during a twilight-into-floodlit round when the temple replicas glow dramatically across the water. Compare both 18-hole loops in Vattanac East vs. West.
Vattanac East anchors our Khmer Kingdom Links and Indochina Golden Age tours, pairing cleanly with Vattanac West and Garden City.

scorecard.gradeBadge: Sir Nick Faldo East Course • Phnom Penh
scorecard.verdict: The East Course plays through grand lakes and dramatic scale models of Angkorian temples. Generous fairways yield to complex multi-tiered greens requiring surgical approach play.

faqs.q: Does Vattanac East Course offer floodlit night golf?
faqs.a: Yes — Vattanac’s East Course features full tournament-grade LED night golf, letting groups tee off late afternoon in cooler air and play beneath dramatic illuminated temple replicas.

faqs.q: Are the Angkor Wat and Khmer temple replicas really on the East Course?
faqs.a: Yes — Sir Nick Faldo and Vattanac integrated intricate stone scale replicas of Preah Vihear, Bayon, and Angkor Wat across the lakes and backdrops of the East Course.

faqs.q: How far is Vattanac East Course from downtown Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Approximately 30 to 40 minutes east of central Phnom Penh by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: When is the prime season to play Vattanac East?
faqs.a: November through March brings dry, sunny Cambodia weather; during the warmer April–October months, early morning or twilight night-golf starts keep conditions comfortable.
